Virginia Woolf, Orlando.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/virginia-woolf/orlando

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Virginia Woolf, the author, died 1941 (United Kingdom (first published London, 1928)).

First publication of the text used: 1928 (colophon: 'published in 1928 by Virginia Woolf').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1928, before 1931;
  a published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after
  publication, so this work entered it in 2023.
- Country of origin (United Kingdom (first published London, 1928)): copyright there lasts for life plus 70 years
  after the death of the last surviving person named above. The last to die
  did so in 1941, so the work entered the public domain there on
  1 January 2012.
